generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected.The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
If any bidder quotes lowest same price to the works and the award of work will be done by Toss or Lottery system.
The amount put to Tender is exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote without GST
Required documents should be uploaded, additionally uploaded documents are not verified by the Department

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A copy of the valid Registration certificate of KPWD Class IV and Above Contractor.
Valid form C Registration certificate from Labour department.
The Earnest money deposit EMD in E-cash NSIC,MSME Certificates are not admissible

Scanned signature of the bidder/representative to be attached while uploading the bid document,The intending bidder shall upload self-attested letter pad mentioning latest Communication address,land phone, mobile Phone and E-mail id.
Bid Capacity AXNX2.50 FOR OTHERS 5.00 for SC,ST,Cat-I,IIA-B Calculation uploaded in Letter Head
Valid Turnover Certificate issued by CA for 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN Number must be uploaded
